title: Needle entry on the patient
view: The upper face from the front: head at the top, the patient's right on the image left, zoomed on the right brow.
teachingPoint: Needle in just above the eyebrow, subcutaneous, aimed medially over the notch on the pupil line; redirect medially in the same plane for the supratrochlear; a finger on the rim below the needle guards the orbit.
claims: Upper face from the front, patient's right on the image left (house laterality; the record names no side).
Supraorbital notch on the superior orbital rim in line with the pupil (record subtitle and step 1).
Entry just above the eyebrow, needle subcutaneous and aimed medially over the notch, tip short of the rim (record steps 3-4).
Dashed: the redirect medially in the same plane toward the bridge of the nose for the supratrochlear nerve (record step 5); its exit about 12 mm medial to the notch is standard anatomy added here.
Gloved finger along the orbital rim below the needle; the needle never points at the orbit (record step 6).
Red dashes: the pupil line. Labels: Supraorbital notch, Supratrochlear nerve.
